adapter_file_comment: File containing extra sequencing adapters for trimomatic and/or cutadapt.
align_jobs_comment: The default number of jobs when splitting apart a blast/fasta36/hmmer alignment.
align_parse_comment: Boolean whether to parse the result of a blast/fasta36/hmmer/etc alignment.
align_blast_format_comment: Choose the alignment type when writing blast alignments, 5 is blastxml which is the most reliably parseable.
arbitrary_comment: Container to hold arbitrary extra arguments to downstream programs.
array_start_comment: When creating array jobs on a cluster, start at this number (for easier sorting).
basedir_comment: Choose the base direectory in which this instance of cyoa will run.
best_only_comment: Keep only the best search result when examining alignments?
bt_larg_comment: I think this is the open gap penalty?
bt_multi_comment: Perform multiple bowtie1 runs with various sensitivities (particularly for tnseq).
bt_varg_comment: Default number of mismatches to allow with bowtie.
bwa_method_comment: Comma separated list of BWA methods to employ.
chosen_tag_comment: When parsing v/bcf files, use this tag.
clean_comment: Clean up detritus after a run?
cluster_comment: Run on a cluster?  If so, name it.
compress_comment: Compress outputs with xz upon completion (use a string to choose another compressor).
condition_column_comment: When examining metadata, use this column to separate groups of interest.
coverage_comment: Use a coverage cutoff for things like bam filter or bcf filter etc?
coverage_tag_comment: Use this tag when filtering for coverage.
csv_file_comment: Use this csv file when reading metadata and such.
cutoff_comment: Arbitrary cutoff when filtering in multiple places.
decoy_comment: Add decoys, particularly salmon and proteomics tools.
delimiter_comment: Default set of delimiters to separate stuff.
denominator_comment: Use this when a denominator is needed.
directories_comment: Repeat the current command over this list of directories.
download_comment: Perform download of the named sample(s)?
end_comment: Use this when defining the start/end of a feature/etc.
fasta_args_comment: Default arguments when using the fasta36 family of tools.
fasta_tool_comment: Use this tool when using faasta36.
fastp_comment: Decide whether to use fastp in a pipeline, boolean or check.
fastqc_comment: Decide whether to use fastqc in a pipeline, boolean or check.
file_column_comment: Use this column from metadata when looking for filenames.
filter_comment: Perform a filter in the various tools/pipelines which are able.
filtered_comment: Tell the tool if the input is filtered.
freebayes: 0 FIXME: Change this to variant_search or something
freebayes_comment: Invoke freebayes in the various pipelines which support it?
gcode_comment: Use this genetic code when translating sequence (bacterial by default).
genome_comment: Specify a genome when examining a sequence.
genus_comment: Choose a genus when using prokka/kraken; if not provided use whatever was first observed.
gff_file: Specify a gff file for inputs/outputs; when guess this is derived from the species argument.
gff_tag: Choose the tag when counting/examining/etc a gff file.
gff_type_comment: Choose a feature type when counting/examining/etc a gff file.
gff_cds_parent_type_comment: When examining a gff file, what is the parent of the CDS feature type?
gff_cds_type_comment: When examining a gff file, which type defines the set of CDS sequences?
htseq_args_comment: Use these arguments when running htseq.
identity_comment: Default % identity cutoff when performing blast/fasta/etc alignments.
index_file_comment: File containing index:sampleID when demultiplexing samples, usually TNSeq.
in_format_comment: Input format when ambiguity is not allowed (bwa).
input_name_comment: A place to put arbitrary input names if one wishes.
interactive_comment: Define if the current invocation is interactive.
introns_comment: Use intron-aware invocations of the various tools?
keys_comment: Separated list of keys when extracting sequences.
kingdom_comment: Use this kingdom for the various taxonomic tools (prokka/kraken), or the first observed.
language_comment: Use this when creating the current job.
length_comment: Specify the length in the current tool (17 for kmers).
library_comment: Specify the library to search against, or guess it.
libtype_comment: Type of sequence library against which to compare: genome/rRNA/contaminants/CDS/etc.
locus_tag_comment: Use this to define gene prefixes when creating bacterial sequence names.
logdir_comment: Use this location to write cluster-specific logs.
loghost_comment: Send logs to this host in slurm/torque/etc.
mapper_comment: Separated list of mappers to employ in a pipeline.
mature_fasta_comment: File containing mature sequence to search (assuming miRNA).
maximum_comment: Catchall argument when a maximum value is required.
max_reads_comment: Maximum number of reads to examine, use all when 0.
mi_genome_comment: Specify a miRbase genome when looking for mature miRNA sequences.
min_depth_comment: Depth minimum when filtering sequence, primarily variant searches.
minimum_comment: Catchall argument when a minimum value is required.
mode_comment: Choose the mode of the current command, currently just htseq.
modelecmd: The command invoked when loading environment modules.
modules_comment: Load these modules for the current command.
numerator_comment: Use this when a numerator is needed.
option_file_comment: Use this file to read options in an asynchronous job.
orientation_comment: When an orientation is helpful, use this.
out_format_comment: Use this output format when ambiguity is not allowed.
outgroup_comment: Outgroup when using the various phylogenetic tools.
output_base_comment: Base directory for all outputs from cwd().
preprocess_dir_comment: Assume this directory when iterating over multiple samples.
primary_key_comment: Choose a key when merging data or querying multiple tables.
product_columns_comment: Delimited set of columns containing gene names/accessions.
product_signal_comment: Delimited set of columns containing signal peptide IDs/accession.
product_transmembrane_comment: Delimited set of columns containing TM domain names/accessions.
protocol_comment: Choose a protocol when appropriate, currently just TNSeq TPP.
query_comment: Specify a query string, primarily used for blast/fasta36.
release_comment: Choose a specific release when downloading a genome/annotation/etc.
ribanchor_comment: Use the start or end of a sequence to anchor riboseq reads.
ribocorrect_comment: Correct ribosome positions given bias information at the start/ends of genes.
ribominpos_comment: Start counting this far upstream of the current CDS in riboseq data.
riboasite_comment: Quantify A site codons in riboseq data.
ribopsite_comment: Quantify P site codons in riboseq data.
riboesite_comment: Quantify E site codons in riboseq data.
ribosizes_comment: Delimited set of read-sizes to use in riboseq data (I had a set in which many of the 28 nt reads were bad.)
runs_comment: Use this number of runs for stuff like Bayesian analyses or bootstraps.
samtools_mapped_comment: Use samtools to extract only mapped reads?
samtools_unmapped_comment: Use samtools to extract only unmapped reads?
search_string_comment: Use this when doing quick searches of logs etc.
separation_comment: Separate reads by this amount when creating reads from a pseudogenome (dantools)
seqid_comment: When a sequence ID is helpful.
shell_path_comment: How to find the shell when creating jobs.
species_comment: Use this species name when appropriate, often for getting fasta/gff/etc files.
start_comment: Start at this position (usually for extracting sub sequences).
starting_tree_comment: Specify a starting tree for phylogenomic methods.
submission_args_comment: FIXME: Split these to separate files for various cluster types. Arguments when submitting jobs to a cluster, defaulting to slurm.
submission_sbatch_depends_comment: Use this for slurm dependency chains.
submission_torque_depends_comment: String to pass when creating a dependency chain on a cluster (slurm by default).
submission_torque_dependsarray_comment: String to pass when creating dependency chains with arrays.
submission_path_comment: Specify a tool to submit jobs to a cluster.
suffixes_comment: Delimited set of suffixes to remove when invoking basename.
ta_offset_comment: In TNSeq, 0 or 2 defines if the TA was removed FIXME: poorly defined
task_comment: Some tools have different options depending on the task, define that here.
taxid_comment: Specify a taxonomy ID, 353 thousand whatever is unknown.
test_file_comment: Specify a file to test for existence or whatever.
translate_comment: Translate nucleotide position information into amino acids when applicable?
variant_filter_comment: Filter variant data by a tag of interest?
version_comment: Choose a specific version of ... whatever ...
vcf_cutoff_comment: Minimum depth cutoff in a vcf file FIXME: use depth above...
vcf_method_comment: Use this tool to examine a vcf/bcf file.
vcf_minpct_comment: Minimum percent agreement for variant searches.
umi_comment: Use umitools to extract umi information from a set of reads/alignments.
